_comment: Sample update cards for the front door prototype, used only when the update feed cannot be reached (the page then says so). These are the real #announcements posts of 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-25, read from GET /api/messages?channel=announcements on 2026-11-02, kept to their four fields. They are posts by the Deploy Bot, not by people.
